schema: Flat ordered node array per frame. Supported group/rect/image/text/path nodes; parentId maps hierarchy. Every layer has precise position, dimensions, rotation, opacity. No photo/image bytes in JSON.
figmaImageResolution: Resolve assetId against imageLookup, verify SHA256 of original photo, create native image fill FIT. Texture uses12% opacity clipped to named paper shape.
rotationMatrix: group.relativeTransform is exact local-to-parent Figma2×3 affine matrix; clockwise y-down convention. Do not rotate readable root text.
